message.content:
Sure thing! To craft a trip that feels just right for you, could you let me know a bit more about your plans?

| What you’d like to know | Why it matters |
|------------------------|----------------|
| **Length of stay** (days) | Helps set the pace and number of sights. |
| **Travel dates / season** | Weather, crowd levels, and special events vary. |
| **Budget range** (per person) | Guides accommodation, dining, and activity choices. |
| **Accommodation style** (hotel, boutique, Airbnb, etc.) | Sets the vibe of your stay. |
| **Interests** (art, history, food, nightlife, shopping, day‑trips, etc.) | Lets me pick the best activities for you. |
| **Travel companions** (solo, couple, family, friends) | Influences transport and lodging options. |
| **Any must‑see or must‑do** (e.g., Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Montmartre, Versailles, etc.) | Prioritizes your itinerary. |

If you’re looking for a quick, ready‑made outline, I can whip up a sample 7‑day itinerary right now—just let me know which of the above details you’re comfortable sharing, or I’ll assume a general “mid‑budget, 7‑day solo traveler” scenario.
